create_job_runner_with_cache: create a JobRunnerWithCache instance with job_info, app_config, and a cache_directory Path
generate_cache_subdirectory: generate a unique cache subdirectory name using get_cache_subdirectory with a configurable number of random digits
init_cache_before_compute: call pre_compute to create a temporary cache directory before running a job
